text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Takamatsunomiya Kinen has come, and the stands are overflowing with enthusiastic fans cheering for Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm worried the pressure might be too much for her. In an attempt to reassure me, Fuji Kiseki smiles brightly…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And accidentally knocks a cup off a table. It's not like her to be so clumsy, so I'm concerned about this incident…
